body:
Infra suggests:
```suggestion
      1. Let |baseHost| be the [=host serializer|serialization=] of |baseURL|'s [=url/host=], if it is not null; otherwise the empty string.
```
But I think initializing _baseHost_ to the empty string and then conditionally overwriting it will be clearer.
